title: TAVELO has Done it AGAIN! *Tavelo GROW Gravel Bike*

takeaways.text: Quoted at US$1,650 for the frameset plus US$300 for Tavelo's gravel bar (September 2026).
Repeats Tavelo's choice of Toray T800 rather than T1000 carbon for compliance and toughness on gravel.
Size 51.5: frame 1,070 g with paint, FIDLOCK cover, bolts and UDH hanger; uncut fork 481 g; seatpost 169 g; 38 cm × 110 mm gravel bar 337 g.
One side of the BSA bottom-bracket shell was poorly faced and needed facing before installation; the rest of the finish impressed him.

disclosure: Unboxing by a US shop-owner YouTuber; how the frameset was obtained is not stated.
summary: Unboxing and component weigh-in of a size 51.5 Tavelo Grow frameset before the GC Performance all-road build.
